pages: {"text": "Apprenticed to the Gearwrights at fourteen. I poured rebar for three gatehouses and cut frames for a fourth.\n\nGood work, all of it. I was proud of it."}
{"text": "The frames were drawn by the masters at the Hollow. Nobody below a master was allowed to see a whole one.\n\nI saw one. I wish I had not."}
